meta.title: Interface for other apps | OpenAmpere
meta.description: How dashboards, scripts and other apps read the values of OpenAmpere and control it: pairing, access, endpoints and commands.

head.note: This page is technical. It is meant for developers who want to connect OpenAmpere with their own app, dashboard or script. You don't need it for Home Assistant; the integration does this for you.
